spans.s: रय् r. 1st cl. (रयते) To go, to move.

रय m. (-यः)
 1. Speed, velocity.
 2. The stream or current of a river.
 3.
Violence, ardour, zeal.
 E. रय् to go, घ aff.

. Wealth.
 E. रय् to go, इन् aff.

रयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Fleetest, very fleet.
 m. (-ष्ठः)
 1.

. BRAHMĀ.
 E. रय speed, quick, (used attributively,) and
इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative.

. Sounding, crying.
 E. रै to sound, aff. ल्युट् ।
रायभाटी f. (-टी) The current or flow of a river.
